Key starter options I recommend we discuss:
- 12-month amortization of the platform fee (option to extend to 24 months at a reduced monthly).
- Starter nodes: minimum 4 inference nodes (license applies per-node).
- Burst capacity: up to 20% monthly free burst for traffic spikes during pilot.
- Pilot credits: $25k of implementation/migration credits applied to the first invoice.
- Support: Silver tier (business hours + 8x5 SRE on-call for incidents) included for pilot; Gold (24x7) optional as add-on.

Hi team,

Putting numbers behind Priyoms outline so Helix has a concrete option to review. Below is a concise commercial example for the 12-month starter bundle (pilot):

Starter Bundle (12-month pilot) — Example quote
- Platform fee (amortized): $120,000 upfront amortized over 12 months = $10,000/month
- Node licenses: 4 nodes x $7,500/mo (per-node rate discounted for pilot) = $30,000/mo
- Estimated monthly usage (tokens/embeddings): billed at metered rate; we estimate ~$8k/mo based on your provided profile
- Support: Silver tier included (SRE on-call during pilot window) = $6,000/mo (discounted)
- Implementation/migration credit: $25,000 credit applied to first invoice
- Air-gap/secure installation surcharge: one-time $12,000 (if requested)
- Pilot burst allowance: 20% free burst above committed node capacity; sustained overages billed at 50% of list node rate

Net effective first-year cashflow (approx): $10k + $30k + $8k + $6k - $25k (credit) + potential one-time surcharges = ~$29k first month, then ~$54k/month after credits.

Two optional commercial levers for Helix:
1) Extend amortization to 24 months to reduce monthly platform fee (drops to $5k/mo) in exchange for a 10% commitment to increase nodes after pilot.
2) Replace node-license model with a seat-based pilot for evaluation only (limit to 20 power-users) at fixed $40k/mo — cleaner OPEX but not ideal for production throughput testing.

Ben: if Helix wants a 24-month amortization example, I can produce an alternate table.

Sofie / Helix procurement: happy to schedule a 30-min call to go line-by-line.

Thanks,
Marissa
Principal Sales
Redwood Inference

Also, can you confirm whether the air-gap surcharge can be reduced if Helix provides a secure local engineering lead and we handle host provisioning? That would help our budget.

Hi Sofie — really appreciate the detail from procurement. Below are Redwoods responses and a counterproposal intended to hit Helixs budget constraints while preserving a meaningful pilot.

1) 24-month amortization option: yes, we can offer a 24-month amortization. Example: platform fee of $120k amortized over 24 months = $5k/mo. Condition: Helix agrees to a non-binding intent to expand to at least 6 nodes by month 13 (to be reviewed jointly) or Redwood provides 60 days notice before changing amortized terms. We can remove the 10% hard commitment and make it an expansion target.

2) Migration credit: we can make the $25k migration credit unconditional for the pilot (i.e., no conversion required). It will be applied to the first invoice.

3) SLT/P1 response: we can include a pilot SLO of 2-hour P1 response and a 4-hour initial workaround commitment during the pilot window. That would be documented in the SOW.

4) Net terms: Redwood accepts PO + Net-30 for pilot with the credit applied to the first invoice. Standard T&Cs apply; procurement exceptions can be escalated.

5) Air-gap surcharge: if Helix provides a named on-site engineering lead and handles host provisioning and firewall rules, we can reduce the one-time air-gap surcharge to $5,000. We require a short checklist to be completed by your lead.

Additional concession: we will include a one-time 10% discount on the first three months of node fees to help onboarding.

Next steps: Marissa will produce a revised term sheet reflecting 24-month amortization and the reduced air-gap fee. Ben and Irene will scope the SOW. Can we schedule a final commercial review on Friday 12/11 at 10:00am PT?

Thanks and talk soon,
Priyom
